aboutUs.heading: About Us
aboutUs.body: At NGen, we don't just teach technology, we engineer the future. We empower learners aged 6 to 18 to become innovators, creators, and leaders who can navigate and shape the digital world with confidence, creativity, and purpose.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.body: To deliver globally accredited, AI-powered education that blends technology, entrepreneurship, and creativity, empowering every learner to lead, innovate, and shine in the digital future.

vision.heading: Our Vision
vision.body: To create a generation that doesn't wait for the future, but designs it. A world where every young mind learns to think critically, build boldly, and lead with purpose.

roadmap.title: Our Courses Tracks
roadmap.subtitle: Six tracks that take your child from curiosity to real-world tech impact.

dataScience.title: Data Science
dataScience.description: Students learn to analyze and visualize data and use it to make predictions, starting from understanding what data is to building simple forecasting models.

programming.title: Programming
programming.description: Students move from Scratch-style animations to full Python applications while learning code structure, debugging, and problem-solving logic.

artificialIntelligence.title: Artificial Intelligence
artificialIntelligence.description: Students design smart systems, train basic machine-learning models, and create simple AI-powered games, progressing from tools like Teachable Machine to beginner Python models.

creativeArts.title: Creative Arts
creativeArts.description: Students explore digital design, animation, and video production, growing from character sketches into polished digital portfolios.

robotics.title: Robotics
robotics.description: Students control hardware and sensors and build IoT projects, starting with LED circuits and evolving into connected smart devices.

cybersecurity.title: Cybersecurity
cybersecurity.description: Students practice digital safety, ethical hacking basics, and network protection, from strong passwords to simple tools that test and secure systems.

tracks.title: Our Tracks
tracks.builtSystemsIntro: Across Data Science, Programming, Artificial Intelligence, Creative Arts, Robotics, and Cybersecurity, students build real systems: smart apps and AI games, robots, dashboards, and secure digital experiences.

journey.title: Your NGen Journey
journey.subtitle: A clear path from beginner to tech leader

placement-test.title: Placement Test
placement-test.longDescription: A comprehensive assessment to determine your current skill level and place you in the perfect starting belt.

white.title: White Belt
white.longDescription: Introduction to the digital world, building curiosity and awareness about technology and its role in our lives.

yellow.title: Yellow Belt
yellow.longDescription: Building the core foundation of coding and logical thinking through block-based programming and computational concepts.

orange.title: Orange Belt
orange.longDescription: Exploring creativity and digital design, learning to express ideas through visual media and interactive projects.

green.title: Green Belt
green.longDescription: Building smart projects that combine AI and robotics concepts, transitioning from blocks to real-world applications.

blue.title: Blue Belt
blue.longDescription: Deep diving into your chosen track, exploring advanced concepts and building specialized skills.

red.title: Red Belt
red.longDescription: Working on advanced projects that push your skills to the next level with real-world complexity.

brown.title: Brown Belt
brown.longDescription: Combining technical skills with innovation and entrepreneurship mindset to create impactful solutions.

black.title: Black Belt
black.longDescription: Conducting research, leading projects, and developing expertise that sets you apart as a tech leader.

ninja.title: Ninja
ninja.longDescription: Becoming a mentor and innovation leader, guiding others while pushing the boundaries of your own expertise.

master.title: Grand Master
master.longDescription: Creating legacy projects with global impact, contributing to the tech community and inspiring the next generation.
